## Introduction

This website is a home for my research, technical projects, notes, and CV. The blog will focus on practical research workflows, choice modelling, environmental economics, and reproducible analysis.

## Planned Topics

- Cleaning and organising choice experiment data
- Estimating and interpreting latent class choice models
- Visualising willingness-to-pay distributions
- Building reproducible Quarto research reports
- Communicating coastal economics results to mixed audiences
